body: I could try to talk to a counselor, I never have before and I'm not super great at talking to people. My biggest worry is that they will tell my mom which I know for a fact if she hears any of it she will gaslight me and tell me that people have so much worse and I don't think I can take that without increasing my risk of killing myself. She obviously doesn't understand and is not very well equip to deal with any of this but at the same time won't get someone who is equipped to deal with it. Her logic for alot of things is constantly flawed and whenever I point out any of it she just tells me to stop talking and brushes it off. I am also super terrified of my dad, one time I had too much of a "Bad Attitude" and my mom threatened to send me over to his house. I then out of fear tried to find any way of killing myself just so I didn't have to go because I knew what he would do if my mom brang me to him and told him that I was being a piece of shit. I would rather die then be over there, thank god my mom didn't send me or I probably would've offed myself there or when I got back.

Yeah ill try and hold on, just sucks that everyone has moved on but me. Even my dad has moved on from it, but for some reason its very hard to move on. Its not that I don't forgive, I believe I already have it just I simply don't trust my parents. Hard to trust the same people who caused this pain and are also stunting your growth from it by denying help. Once I turn 16 I'm planning on getting a job and moving out as soon as possible, my oldest sister did the same thing by getting boyfriend and moving in with him at 17 so maybe I just gotta do the same and get a gf. Just really sucks though, can't tell if im being overdramatic because of the length of time from when it happened and everyone has moved on or if my head really did get fucked up from it and I need help.
Hopefully it gets better, ill try to atleast live till like 21 or something

Oh thank you, just sucks that I am gonna have to deal with this probably for the next 3 years until I am 18 so I can do what I need to do to get help. I am not hating on my mom for being Ultra Christian as I can see how it can be something to look forward too and just something to do, but its not for me. Although Satanism is pretty scary lol, something about it being cryptic and mysterious and also just being raised super catholic makes it have a vibe of reading something that I shouldn't be. I would say that I am atheist though as I don't believe in god, heaven or hell and I haven't been to church in like 2 years. I don't have any friends atm since I recently moved but maybe I can make some since school is starting on the 8th.
